comment: Jesse-blessed 2026-07-28. Tier = pool-size tier x depth tier (grid). Sizing = min(curve, poolCap, blueprint). All editable; the dashboard editor writes here.
tvlSourceNote: boundaries are FRACTIONS of total crypto TVL (DefiLlama) so they breathe with the cycle per MASTER-FORMULA.md Step 5a; cache TVL daily, fallback to last-known

grid.comment: poolTier x depthTier -> L (3=high risk/red, 2=medium/yellow, 1=low/green). From NARRATIVE-AND-LIQUIDITY-V2.md

curveRules: below first anchor: FLAT at 0.005%. Between anchors: LOG-LOG linear interpolation (interpolate ln(pct) against ln(pool)). Above last anchor: capped at 5%.

blueprint.ccmSource: tools/market-direction/market-direction.json buy_size_multiplier (re-run tools/market-direction/refresh.js if older than 24h; keyless)

overrides.note: per-contract tier overrides Jesse sets from the card, e.g. {"0xabc...": 2}
